question: Should omitted `plugins.entries.active-memory.config.agents` mean every configured agent, only the default `main` agent, or no targets unless explicitly configured?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes a shipped, compatibility-sensitive Active Memory default that can alter which sessions receive memory context, and repository policy treats config/default/fallback changes as maintainer-owned product direction.

options.title: Approve configured-agents default
options.body: Land this direction after current-head proof and checks if maintainers accept omission as all configured agents or `main`.

options.title: Narrow to default main
options.body: Fix the linked single-agent command bug with less multi-agent blast radius, keeping multi-agent operators on explicit allowlists.

options.title: Keep explicit-only targeting
options.body: Reject the default change and update setup, docs, or doctor guidance so users add the desired agent list explicitly.

recommendation.title: Approve configured-agents default
recommendation.body: Land this direction after current-head proof and checks if maintainers accept omission as all configured agents or `main`.
